name: To Love-Ru Diary~ - Gold
original_name: とらぶるだいあり～・ごーるど
source:
An assassin girl has arrived suddenly from outer space.
Her plan is to kill the young boy who meets her...!
However, when he saves her from some despicable slime,
her heart becomes lenient... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102437.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位少女杀手突然从外太空来到这里。

她的目标，是杀死与她相遇的少年…！

然而，当少年把她从卑劣的史莱姆手中救下后，

她的心开始软化…

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102437.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语页面[/url]]
